RBP-006: the only shared mutation in changed src is the process-wide Mutex<HashMap<_, Weak<LoggerInner>>> in obs.rs. It is documented (one writer per service and root), recovers from poison with PoisonError::into_inner, and the last Arc drop owns shutdown. I judged it justified.
RBP-007: no fake Result paths. Result<_, LogRejected> in log_event and action_name can really fail. The Drop impl's `let _ =` on flush/shutdown is commented as best-effort.

RBP-003/008: the changed crates add no new pub trait. SessionLog and JudgeBackend are pre-existing dyn-used traits in unchanged crates, are object-safe (Send + Sync, no generic methods) and are used as Arc<dyn ...>.

RBP-002/005/009/010: no lifecycle state machine, wrapper-forwarding noise, hot-path cloning or capability-token need was found in the changed code. HostRun is a simple prepare-then-run split that consumes self.
